issues.evidence: Eq. 4: why could you drop the Jacobian term? The DreamFusion training objective can be justified from the perspective of variational inference + sticking the landing. But it is not well-justified in the case of this paper.

issues.formula_location: Equation (9) – LHS independence vs RHS independence
issues.evidence: From the LHS in equation (9), it follows that conditioned on the parents the variable is independent of the ancestors. From the RHS in equation (9), it is not clear if the same independence condition holds.

If H is a discrete random variable and all other variables are Gaussians, then Z1,Z2,Z3,Z4 conditional on H=h, follows a Gaussian distribution. Note that in the above DAG, Z3 conditioned on Z2 is not independent of Z1 as there is a path from Z3 to Z1 through H. The LHS of equation (9) requires that each Z_i is independent of its ancestors conditioned on its parents in Z. Thus there is a contradiction.
The authors should provide examples of the data generation process that follows this assumption.
